note: Computed in-script as normalizedDifference(B8, B4) on a cloud-masked growing-season median. Snow-free window matters at 56 N - widen or shift it if the median comes back mostly cloud.
Copernicus GLO-30. Mosaicked before use because GLO30 is served as tiles. NASA/NASADEM_HGT/001 (band 'elevation') is the drop-in alternative if GLO30 access fails.
Derived in-script with ee.Terrain.slope() from the elevation band above - matches terra::terrain(dem, v='slope', unit='degrees') in the offline path, so no separate asset is needed.
ESA WorldCover v200. Categorical - use it to stratify or mask, never as a continuous predictor. Sothe et al. used Canadian Land Cover 2019 for masking; this is the public stand-in.
Permanent water (class 80) from WorldCover, inverted into a land mask. The primary prior is already NoData over open water; this makes the same exclusion explicit for the covariates.
